reminders.text: Coach Green (Oct 30): until 70% of athletes are passing, study hall and missing assignments take priority over athletic development. Check Ethan's grades and missing work this weekend.
7th grade: Mon doors open 6:45 AM CT, position room 7:00 AM CT. Tue doors open 1st period with gear turn in (week of Oct 26).
Failing grades mean ineligible to play. Keep grades up.
After games Ethan turns in his jersey and pants, so bring shorts.
Coach Green posts the weekly schedule in the sportsYou team feed Fri–Sun, usually by early Sunday evening. This site gets updated from it.
7th grade basketball tryouts Wed Oct 28: doors open 6:40 AM CT, tryouts start 7:00 AM CT. Thu–Fri mornings are 8th grade tryouts.
Outdoor games: leave 1 hr 10 min before kickoff. Coach wants players there 40 min early. Indoor at Stampede: leave 45 min before.
Kit color comes from TeamSnap's Uniform field for each game. "Not posted yet" means the coach hasn't set it in TeamSnap.
Fall Concert Thu Oct 29 is REQUIRED (call 7:00 PM CT). Wear band shirt, blue jeans, close-toed shoes or a school-appropriate costume.
